record.one_liner: Ecwid (by Lightspeed) is a hosted e-commerce platform that adds an online store to existing websites and social/marketplace channels.
record.auth_notes: Custom app (single store): copy the secret token from the app dashboard and send it as a Bearer token in the Authorization header. A public token exists for public store data only. Public/external apps use OAuth 2.0: authorization code exchanged via POST to https://my.ecwid.com/api/oauth/token with client_id, client_secret, code, redirect_uri and grant_type=authorization_code. Token passing in query params was discontinued March 2025. Tokens are reported not to expire; that comes from a search snippet and I did not fetch the page.
record.access_notes: The setup page says "Only stores on paid plans can access API." Ecwid offers a free upgrade to a paid plan for integration testing on a non-production store, store customization projects, public App Market apps and Instant Site templates. For a test store, you email Ecwid support. A custom app is created automatically the first time you open the app dashboard.
record.blocker: API needs a paid store plan (a free upgrade for testing can be requested from support). Rate limit is 600 requests/min per token. The only vendor MCP found is a docs-search MCP (https://docs.ecwid.com/~gitbook/mcp), not a store-operations server. Third-party MCP connectors exist (Zapier, Pipedream and others), which I did not verify.

evidence.auth: https://docs.ecwid.com/get-started/make-your-first-api-request (Bearer secret token from custom app Details page); https://docs.ecwid.com/changelog/march-2025/march-20/oauth-for-public-apps-get-request-type-changed-to-post (OAuth POST token endpoint)
